properties.description: Data collection rule for WithSecure Elements security events

dataFlows.transformKql: source | extend TimeGenerated = now(), EventId = tostring(id), Severity = tostring(severity), ServerTimestamp = datetime_add('millisecond', tolong(serverTimestamp), make_datetime(1970, 1, 1)), PersistenceTimestamp = datetime_add('millisecond', tolong(persistenceTimestamp), make_datetime(1970, 1, 1)), Message = tostring(message), Description = tostring(description), Engine = tostring(engine), Action = tostring(action), Details = parse_json(tostring(details)), OrganizationId = tostring(parse_json(tostring(organization)).id), OrganizationName = tostring(parse_json(tostring(organization)).name), DeviceId = tostring(parse_json(tostring(device)).id), DeviceName = tostring(parse_json(tostring(device)).name), DeviceWinsName = tostring(parse_json(tostring(device)).winsName), DeviceClientType = tostring(parse_json(tostring(device)).clientType) | project TimeGenerated, EventId, Severity, ServerTimestamp, PersistenceTimestamp, Message, Description, Engine, Action, Details, OrganizationId, OrganizationName, DeviceId, DeviceName, DeviceWinsName, DeviceClientType
